description:
`.coverage-threshold` currently reads `84`. It was lowered from `87` in
`d5438ba08` (PR #80, 2026-08-24) as construction scaffolding, and
`.github/workflows/ci.yml:45-47` says so in as many words:

    # .coverage-threshold is temporarily lowered (84) while fz-9i4.7
    # defers the broad red compiler2 fixtures; fz-9i4.7.8 restores it to
    # 87 as those fixtures re-enable. Keep it a bare number -- it is cat'd.

The condition that justified the slack is gone. fz-9i4.7 is CLOSED, and the
explicit path deferrals are down to 9 `defer.<lane>` lines across three fixtures
-- enum_tier0 (fz-kdt.1, fz-kdt.3), fz_f98_map_reduce (fz-kdt.1),
enumerable_protocol_dispatch (fz-bv3) -- each naming a live blocker.

## Work

MEASURE FIRST, then set the floor to the strongest value the current line
universe actually supports. The intent is 87. Do not change fixtures, deferrals,
or production code in this ticket, and do not rebaseline downward.

## Correction to the previous description

It cited `939fdacdf` reporting 87,072/97,750 = 89.0762% covered with
`--fail-under-lines 87` passing. That commit is NOT an ancestor of main
(`git merge-base --is-ancestor 939fdacdf HEAD` fails), and it predates the
lowering, so it is not evidence about the current tree. It also said "11 explicit
path deferrals across four fixtures"; it is 9 across three. Take a fresh
measurement rather than trusting either number.

## Checks

- `cat .coverage-threshold` reads 87.
- `cargo llvm-cov --all-features --workspace --fail-under-lines "$(cat .coverage-threshold)"`
  passes on a fresh run.
- The temporary comment in .github/workflows/ci.yml naming this ticket is deleted
  in the same commit -- the scaffolding note goes when the scaffolding does.
title: Restore the 87 percent coverage floor: .coverage-threshold is still the temporary 84 lowered in PR 80
